description:
**Winner of the Excellence Award at the BL & GL Contest**

Though born a concubine’s son, Yeonseok possessed outstanding skill. Eventually cast out of his family, he now lives in a remote border region, content with his quiet life.

One day, his older brother Juseok, from whom he was estranged ten years ago, appears and speaks of wanting to capture the “mermaid” rumored in whispers. Hearing this, Yeonseok is reminded of the mermaid who saved him when he nearly drowned as a child.

A scholar cursed into becoming a mermaid, and Yeonseok, who has received his help not once but twice. Together, they weave a beautiful historical BL tale.

[Original Webtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/swim_arrow/)
